# Derm Audit Journal

> Independent clinical reviews and ingredient breakdowns of top anti-aging collagen renewal creams, neuro-dermal expression line serums, botanical skin brightening correctors, under-eye therapies, and scar reduction recovery formulas.

## Core Navigation
- [Review Portal](/index.html): Comparative landing page for top skincare products. Features ratings, side-by-side details, and dynamic matching tools.
- [Comparison Matrix](/comparison.html): Full side-by-side clinical comparison tables evaluating 5 top-tier clinical solutions (Kollagen Intensiv, Synevra UltraLift, Illuminatural 6i, Eyelasticity, Dermefface FX7) against luxury market alternatives.
- [Skincare Conflict Matrix](/tools/skincare-conflict-matrix.html): Interactive dermatological engine calculating pH compatibility, deactivation risks, and routine conflict checks across 11 clinical actives.
- [Skin Quiz](/index.html#skin-quiz): 3-question javascript skin matching tool. Connects specific skin concerns to recommended products.
- [Bio Link Page](/links.html): Branded mobile navigation portal optimized for social media referral traffic.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy.html): GDPR, CCPA, and FTC regulatory compliance disclosures.
- [About Derm Audit Journal](/about.html): Who we are, how the site is funded, and our editorial independence.
- [Audit Methodology](/methodology.html): How formulas, the 42 interaction rules, and manufacturer figures are reviewed.
- [Contact Editorial Desk](/contact.html): Corrections, restock updates, and privacy requests.

## Clinical Reviews
- [Kollagen Intensiv Review](/kollagen-intensiv-review.html): In-depth review of Kollagen Intensiv. Analyzes patented peptide Syn-Coll® (the manufacturer reports that it boosts collagen synthesis by 354% and reduces wrinkle depth by 84%).
- [Synevra UltraLift Review](/synevra-ultralift-review.html): Formulation analysis of Synevra UltraLift peptide system. Evaluates SYN-AKE® neuromuscular relaxation mechanism (the manufacturer reports up to an 82% reduction in micro-contractions) and VitaLock™ oral beauty nutrients.
- [Illuminatural 6i Review](/illuminatural-6i-review.html): In-depth analysis of Illuminatural 6i skin brightener. Evaluates six botanical actives (including Alpha-Arbutin and Niacinamide) that the manufacturer reports block melanin synthesis without hydroquinone.
- [Eyelasticity Review](/eyelasticity-review.html): Formulation analysis of Eyelasticity Age-Defying Eye Therapy. Evaluates multi-peptide complex (Eyeseryl®, Regu®-Age, Syn®-Coll, and Pro-Coll-One+) that the manufacturer reports reduces under-eye puffiness and dark circles within 15 to 28 days.
- [Dermefface FX7 Review](/dermefface-fx7-review.html): Formulation review of Dermefface FX7 Scar Reduction Therapy. Explains remodeling actives (including 10% Symglucan and 2% Pro-Coll-One+) that the manufacturer reports boost Type I collagen by up to 1,190% to help flatten scars.

- [Research Journal](/blog.html): Main research index covering comparative ingredient studies, peptide mechanisms, and barrier defense benchmarks.
- [Under-Eye Circles Science Article](/blog-under-eye-circles-microcirculation.html): Clinical study on periorbital microcirculation, leaky capillaries, and peptide lymphatic drainage.
- [Syn-Coll vs Retinol Article](/blog-syn-coll-vs-retinol.html): Clinical comparison between Palmitoyl Tripeptide-5 and Retinol.
- [Dermal Scar Remodeling Article](/blog-how-to-fade-acne-scars.html): Research paper on scar tissue remodeling using Symglucan and peptides.
- [Alpha-Arbutin vs Hydroquinone Article](/blog-alpha-arbutin-vs-hydroquinone.html): Clinical study on tyrosinase enzyme inhibition and safe melanin control.
- [SYN-AKE vs Argireline Guide](/syn-ake-vs-argireline.html): Biochemical comparative analysis of SNARE complex inhibition vs acetylcholine receptor blocking for dynamic expression line relaxation.
